Text: Makanan halal sedap di Kuala Lumpur! Restoran Seri Melayu ada nasi lemak terbaik. Sambal dia memang power, santan pun creamy. Harga berpatutan, service pun bagus. Highly recommended untuk breakfast!
Baru try kedai mamak Pelita di Bangsar. Roti canai dia crispy, curry kambing sedap gila! Teh tarik pun kaw. Open 24 jam, perfect untuk supper. Halal certified, so no worries.
Village Park Restaurant nasi lemak memang legend! Queue panjang tapi worth it. Ayam rendang dia juicy, sambal not too spicy. Located kat Damansara Uptown. Must try kalau kat KL!
Warung Pak Su kat Kampung Baru ada laksa Johor authentic. Taste macam kat Johor, thick gravy dengan ikan. Portion besar, harga RM8 je. Tempat simple tapi makanan sedap!

Restoran Rebung Chef Ismail famous dengan masakan Melayu tradisional. Rendang tok dia soft melting, gulai tempoyak pun unique. Ambiance nice, suitable untuk family dinner. Pricey sikit tapi quality ada.
Jalan Alor food street memang heaven untuk halal food lovers! Banyak pilihan - satay, char kway teow halal, cendol, rojak. Atmosphere lively, perfect untuk malam-malam lepak dengan kawan.
Nasi Arab Hadramout kat Ampang ada lamb mandi terbaik! Rice dia fragrant, lamb tender. Comes with soup and salad. Authentic Middle Eastern taste. Halal certified. Price around RM25-30.
likes: Dim sum halal kat Yum Cha Chinatown memang rare find! Har gow, siu mai semua halal. Taste authentic macam non-halal version. Weekend ramai orang, better book table dulu.

Text: Bazar Ramadan Jalan TAR every year memang best! Variety of kuih, murtabak, air tebu fresh. Harga reasonable, quality pun okay. Good place untuk berbuka puasa shopping dengan family.
Secret Recipe cake dia sedap, especially chocolate indulgence. All outlets halal certified. Good untuk birthday celebration atau just coffee session. Service consistent across all branches.
Restoran Oversea kat Imbi famous dengan Hainanese chicken rice halal. Chicken tender, rice fragrant. Been operating since 1960s. Old school taste yang authentic. Must visit kalau suka chicken rice!
Madam Kwan's nasi lemak with rendang chicken memang signature dish. Coconut rice perfect, rendang rich in flavor. Bit expensive tapi portion generous. Good untuk special occasion.
Warung Apek kat Setapak ada mee rebus terbaik! Gravy thick and flavorful, toppings generous. Harga student-friendly RM6 je. Popular dengan locals, always packed during lunch time.
Sate Kajang Hj Samuri memang original! Daging lembu dan ayam fresh, bumbu kacang creamy. Ketupat dia pun sedap. Multiple branches around KL. Consistent quality across all outlets.
Restoran Seri Angkasa kat KL Tower ada buffet halal dengan view KL skyline. Food variety okay, view memang spectacular especially malam. Good untuk tourists atau special celebration.
Kedai kopi traditional kat Petaling Street ada kopi-o kaw and half-boiled eggs. Simple breakfast tapi satisfying. Atmosphere old school, good untuk morning lepak session.
Nasi Dagang Terengganu kat Wangsa Maju authentic taste! Fish curry rich, coconut rice aromatic. Hard to find good nasi dagang kat KL, this place delivers. Worth the drive!
Restoran Kapitan famous dengan tandoori chicken and naan bread. Indian Muslim cuisine yang authentic. Spice level just nice, not too hot. Good untuk yang suka Indian food.
Pasar malam Taman Connaught every Wednesday ada variety halal street food. Apam balik, rojak, cendol semua ada. Harga murah, quality okay. Good untuk family outing.
Restoran Nelayan kat Ampang specializes dalam seafood halal. Butter prawns, sweet sour fish, salted egg crab semua sedap. Fresh seafood, reasonable price. Popular dengan locals.
